group_assessment.weighting: A narrative review of ERBB4 in the HPA axis and neurodegeneration. It states in its own Conclusions that ERBB4 as a causal bridge between HPA dysregulation and neurodegeneration is 'largely speculative' and rests on constitutive knockout and acute-stress rodent models. It never mentions WWOX, so any WWOX link runs only through the WWOX-ErbB4 partnership recorded elsewhere; this paper adds no evidence about that partnership.

entries.proposition: The authors call the ERBB4 causal-bridge proposal a largely speculative working hypothesis.
entries.snippet: the proposed role of ERBB4 as a causal bridge between HPA dysregulation and neurodegenerative pathology may be a promising but largely speculative working hypothesis

entries.proposition: The mechanism evidence rests on knockout or acute stress models.
entries.snippet: these observations were made based on constitutive knockout or acute stress models

entries.proposition: Rodent ErbB4-deficient mice show regional dopamine changes: reduced in prefrontal cortex, hippocampus and nucleus accumbens, elevated in dorsal striatum.
entries.snippet: In ErbB4-deficient mice, steady-state DA levels were reduced in the medial prefrontal cortex, hippocampus, and nucleus accumbens, but they were elevated in the dorsal striatum

entries.proposition: Loss of ERBB4 is reported to increase noradrenergic neuron firing and norepinephrine levels.
entries.snippet: Loss or knockout of ERBB4 resulted in an increased rate of spontaneous firing of noradrenergic neurons and increased levels of norepinephrine

entries.proposition: ERBB4 is reported to be expressed in the adrenal cortex and to alter systemic corticosterone/cortisol surges after stress when NRG1 or ERBB4 are disturbed.
entries.snippet: NRG1 or ERBB4 dysfunction altered the systemic corticosterone/cortisol surges after stress, supporting the role of ERBB4 in maintaining physiological steroidogenesis at the adrenal level

entries.proposition: Parkinson's disease: ERBB4 neuroprotection comes from acute neurotoxin models that do not model chronic alpha-synucleinopathy.
entries.snippet: did not properly reflect the chronic, progressive α-synucleinopathy of PD

entries.proposition: Clinical HPA associations in Parkinson's disease do not prove a causal link involving ERBB4.
entries.snippet: these associations did not prove a direct causal link involving ERBB4 mutations in PD patients

entries.proposition: Human ERBB4 genetic findings in FTD-ALS are mostly single cases or one family.
entries.snippet: most FTD-ALS variants were reported in single cases or one family

entries.proposition: ERBB4 outcomes are context-dependent: protective in some neurons, damaging under amyloid stress in hippocampal neurons.
entries.snippet: The functional outcome of ERBB4 signaling in neurodegeneration was not uniformly beneficial or damaging
